key_insight: GPU-based meet-in-the-middle braid compilation finds Fibonacci-anyon gates in the [CNOT] class with leakage and class error both around 10⁻¹⁰ at braid length 69.
engineering_relevance: The approach improves numerical compilation of low-leakage two-qubit topological gates, addressing unwanted transitions outside the computational subspace.
method: Exhaustively search the full positive five-generator braid alphabet through length 21.
Reach lengths up to 72 using restricted generators, boundary-σ₃ and palindromic braids, and Garside left normal forms.
Derive leakage lower bounds and limiting distributions to compare exhaustive search with random sampling.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports leakage around 10⁻³ and [CNOT]-class error around 10⁻⁸ in the full search through length 21, plus a length-69 braid achieving both around 10⁻¹⁰.
watch_item: Longer searches restrict the braid space, so their best results do not establish optimality over all braids or demonstrate performance on physical hardware.
paper_title: Meet-in-the-Middle Compilation of the $[\mathrm{CNOT}]$ Class with Fibonacci Anyons
